description: Variation of Condition 2 (Approved Drawings) of planning permission ref. 2021/1831 (amalgamation of flats into a single dwelling and extensions) to allow alterations to the approved side extension, provision of vehicular access and associated changes to boundary treatments and hard landscaping.
decision_conditions: <p><span style="color: rgb(51, 51, 51);">The proposed development would introduce material changes that </span><span style="color: rgb(34, 34, 34); font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: small;">would require a variation to the terms of the “operative” part of the original planning permission </span><span id="m_-8383425890118718159gmail-docs-internal-guid-c70aab88-7fff-0f66-c866-d5aa1a18716a" style="color: rgb(34, 34, 34); font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: small;"><span style="font-size: 10pt; font-family: Arial, sans-serif; color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; vertical-align: baseline;">2021/1831, dated </span></span><span id="m_-8383425890118718159gmail-docs-internal-guid-7bd089d6-7fff-39e2-4a97-83eb17e672fb" style="color: rgb(34, 34, 34); font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: small;"><span style="font-size: 10pt; font-family: Arial, sans-serif; color: rgb(0, 0, 0); background-color: transparent; font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; vertical-align: baseline;">09/08/2021</span><span style="font-size: 10pt; font-family: Arial, sans-serif; color: rgb(0, 0, 0); background-color: transparent; font-weight: 700; font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; vertical-align: baseline;">. </span></span><span style="color: rgb(51, 51, 51);">As a result this proposal goes beyond the scope of Section 73 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 (as amended) and is contrary to guidance within the National Planning Practice Guidance, specifically paragraph 001 Reference ID: 17a-001-20140306.</span></p>

<p><span id="docs-internal-guid-916eb278-7fff-6519-efe5-9e966b63f3c4"></span></p><div><span style="background-color: transparent; font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; white-space-collapse: preserve; text-align: justify;">The development, by reason, its design, detailing and materials fails to respect the architectural character and proportions of the host building and introduces incongruous features that detract from the character and appearance of the property. The works have resulted in less than substantial harm to the significance of the De Beauvoir Conservation Area, which is not outweighed by any public benefits. The proposal therefore fails to preserve or enhance the character and appearance of the conservation area and is contrary to Section 72(1) of the Planning (Listed Buildings and Conservation Areas) Act 1990, Policies D3 and HC1 of the London Plan (2021), Policies LP1 and LP3 of the Hackney Local Plan, the Residential Extensions and Alterations SPD (2025), and the De Beauvoir Conservation Area Appraisal.</span></div>

<p><span id="docs-internal-guid-09a84e45-7fff-7542-b50f-fa25d5b79357"><span style="font-size: 10pt; font-family: Arial, sans-serif; background-color: transparent; font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline; white-space-collapse: preserve;">The development, by reason of the creation of hardstanding within the rear garden and the absence of sufficient information demonstrating how additional surface water runoff would be managed, fails to demonstrate that it would not adversely affect surface water drainage and flood risk. Furthermore, the loss of soft landscaping and biodiversity features associated with the approved scheme, including the failure to provide the approved green roof on the ground floor extension, has resulted in a reduction in biodiversity value on the site. The proposal is therefore contrary to Policies SI12, SI13, G5 and G6 of the London Plan and Policies LP46, LP47 and LP53 of the Hackney Local Plan.</span></span></p>

<p><span id="docs-internal-guid-fcbd46e8-7fff-91db-9818-c01381b35cb7"><span style="font-size: 10pt; font-family: Arial, sans-serif; background-color: transparent; font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline; white-space-collapse: preserve;">The development, by reason of the introduction of a new vehicular access, dropped kerb and off-street parking area, which result with the loss of garden space and boundary treatment to facilitate vehicle parking, is contrary to the Council's car-free development objectives and sustainable transport policies. The proposal would undermine the character of the streetscene and encourage private vehicle use within a highly accessible location. The proposal is therefore contrary to Policies LP43 and LP45 of the Hackney Local Plan. </span></span></p>
